code_review_of_fix: FloatingRichTextToolbar.jsx L2048-2057: Fallback `if (block === null) block = 'P';` is placed AFTER the ancestor walk and AFTER the align-block ancestor lookup. Comment accurately documents intent and limits scope to the detector only — no formatting command or DOM mutation touched. ✓

The fallback is unconditional on `block === null`. This means in TEXTAREA plaintext mode (where refreshActive short-circuits at L1976-1980 and returns early), the fallback does NOT execute — correct, no regression there. ✓
Mutual exclusivity preserved because the fallback only fires when NO other block was detected; it cannot overwrite a found H1/H2/H3/LI. ✓

Non-regression for inline formats (bold/italic/underline/strike) — their classification is independent of `block` and the setActive guard still compares all fields; verified in previous iteration and unaffected by this change.

rca_of_the_issue: Previously, refreshActive classified a caret position by walking ancestors looking for P/H1/H2/H3/LI. For bare top-level Text nodes (produced by the applyBlock H1 operation on sibling lines), that walk returned null and no block button lit up. The one-line fallback `if (block === null) block = 'P';` treats the 'no block ancestor' case as an implicit paragraph, which matches browser default rendering of bare text as left-aligned paragraph flow. User-visible highlight restored. Mutual exclusivity preserved. No side effects on inline-format detection or formatting commands.
